en.headline: Private car hits railing and overturns in Kennedy Town, three unhurt
en.dek: Police said the driver and two passengers climbed out after the car flipped onto its side near Smithfield Municipal Services Building early Tuesday; the driver's breath test read zero.
body: A private car crashed into a railing and overturned in Kennedy Town early on Tuesday, but the driver and two passengers escaped without injury, police said.

The accident happened around midnight as the car travelled along Rock Hill Street towards Smithfield Road. Near the Smithfield Municipal Services Building, the driver apparently lost control, hitting about five to six metres of railing on the right pavement before the car flipped onto its left side.

Passers-by called police, fearing someone might be trapped. Officers and rescuers who arrived found the three occupants had already climbed out; none were injured. The driver's breath test returned a zero reading.
The driver told police he had borrowed his father's car. Photos from the scene showed the rear door open, items scattered on the road, and damage to the right front end and wheels.

zh.headline: 堅尼地城私家車撞欄翻側 三人自行爬出幸無受傷
zh.dek: 警方指周二凌晨事發於石山街近士美菲路市政大樓，司機及兩名乘客已自行爬出，酒精測試讀數為零。
body: 周二凌晨，一輛私家車在堅尼地城撞向欄杆後翻側，司機及兩名乘客均無受傷，警方表示。
事發於午夜左右，涉事私家車沿石山街往士美菲路方向行駛，駛近士美菲路市政服務大樓時懷疑失控，先撞向右邊行人路約五至六米欄杆，其後車輛向左翻側。
途人擔心有人被困報警。救援人員到場後，發現車上三人已自行爬出車廂，經檢查均無受傷。警方為司機進行酒精呼氣測試，結果讀數為零。
司機向警方表示當時駕駛的是父親的私家車。現場照片顯示尾門打開，雜物散落路面，右邊車頭及車輪有損毀。
